description:
Anjali Talreja Psychologist moderated and professionally guided an interactive session on developing coping skills to navigate some of Life's important transitions. The empty nest - Adjusting to life when children leave home, loss of Partner - Coping with Grief, loneliness and rebuilding life., Growng Older with Children - Naviagting changing relationships expectations and emotional needs as we go

Also we celebrated Dushera - fellowship - bonds forever
